verdict.rationale: Asking whether an engine ships as an importable, bundleable npm-style library is a fair question for a game engine, so this axis applies. Unity's evidence shows an Editor-centric workflow: WebGL is a build/export target from the Editor, and the UPM registry and Package Manager deliver packages into Unity projects, not into a web developer's own bundler toolchain. Nothing in the pack shows Unity being installed, imported, bundled or tree-shaken as a web dependency.
